profile.name: 垂直反射镜模拟组件
profile.description: 非物理软件组件，用于在实验控制中模拟双支撑/双千斤顶垂直反射镜的运动与几何换算。它支持原始执行量与派生镜面参数之间的转换，并可按派生目标参数进行设定，适合测试控制逻辑与坐标变换。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component that simulates a two-support/two-jack vertical mirror for experiment control. It converts between raw actuator values and derived mirror parameters, and allows the mirror state to be set using derived targets, making it useful for testing control logic and coordinate transforms.
